name: finish_transcript_never_lands
description: SCA-4385 variant, synthetic (from the review of #26304). The incident's capture with fast finish off, and B's batch transcript never lands. A lands inside the Finish wait. The cut must survive the wait: the Finish conversation holds A and F, is a manual end and is visible on Home.

budget.note: Measured 2026-11-26 (277 reads, 70 writes, 1 delete(s), 10 no-op, 0 STT, 7 LLM; caps about +10%). noop_writes=10 is the current count, not a target: every one is database/conversations_v3_leases.py:72 renew (service.reconcile run_blocking renew) rewriting the lease until at the instant it was claimed. The lab clock does not move inside one event; production's does, so this is a lab-clock repeat, reported in the PR.
